articles.summary: Hafnia has been named the winner of the Danish Shipping Diversity Award 2026. This year’s award, themed “Small changes, big impact,” recognizes smaller initiatives that make a difference in organizational culture and employees’ everyday working lives. articles.title: Hafnia Wins Danish Shipping Diversity Award 2026

articles.summary: The Regional Maritime University (RMU) recently held its 20th Congregation graduation ceremony marking the end of years of study for hundreds of cadets. Hafnia’s ties with RMU date back to March 2023, when the two signed a Memorandum of Understanding to bring top cadets from West Africa aboard Hafnia vessels for their cadetships and first roles at sea. Since then, the partnership has grown through guest lectures, mentoring, and a steady pipeline of graduates joining the fleet. articles.title: Hafnia Supports 25 Newly Graduated Cadets at Regional Maritime University's 20th Graduation
